items.note: t7 now follows a test-only Link back to '/' after sign-out and asserts the login heading, no 'Signed in as', and no Authorization-bearing call after sign-out. The no-op signOut variant (a1) now fails t7. A valid authFetch that omits the header for a null token still passes 8/8.

t6 now expires tokens and clicks Request restart as admin, then asserts the login page with the session-expired notice and no not-allowed alert. The every-error-is-403 variant (a2) now fails t6. The README and TASK now say a 401 goes to sessionExpired().

With VITE_API_URL stubbed, t8 now signs in and loads the list, and asserts every recorded call URL starts with the stubbed base. The stub routes on the URL pathname, so absolute URLs still work. The hard-coded '/api' authFetch variant (a3) now fails t8.
jsonResponse now returns a real Response. The text()+JSON.parse authFetch variant (a4) passes 8/8, and a Headers-object variant passes 8/8.

t3-t7 now vi.mock dev-auth.js to start signed out, and the README lists the remaining couplings accurately (tests 3-8 need tasks 1 and 3; tests 5-8 also need task 2; only test 8 checks dev-auth.js). With the reference solution plus the shipped dev-auth.js (a8), only t8 fails (7/8). On the starter, t3-t8 fail on the task-3 guard.

The TASK 8 comment and the README troubleshooting now say the call-time read is a testability requirement for vi.stubEnv, and that in a real Vite app the value is fixed at dev-server start or build, so you restart or rebuild. That is accurate. The module-level read (a6) still fails t8, as stated.
The dev mock (line 36) and the test stub now accept only /^Bearer (.+)$/. The bare-token variant (a9) now fails t1, t2 and t5-t8 instead of only t2, and the dev server would answer 401.
The node prerequisite is now '^22.12.0 || >=24' (line 30) and the README matches. Both are consistent with vitest 4.1.12 engines in the tests lockfile.
